# Actions

## Button

`import { Button, buttonVariants, defaultButtonTone } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'solid' \| 'soft' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost' \| 'link'` | `'solid'` |  |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` |  | Defaults to `primary` for `solid` and `link`, `neutral` for the rest. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | One glyph and no label: square, round, and it needs an `aria-label`. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Waiting on what the press started: a spinner before the label, `aria-busy`, and disabled so a second press cannot repeat it. A loading link drops its `href`, as a disabled one does. |
| `children` | `Snippet` |  |  |

Also takes: every `<button>` attribute; every `<a>` attribute.

Also exports: `buttonVariants`, `defaultButtonTone`.

Types: `ButtonSize` (`'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`), `ButtonVariant` (`'solid' | 'soft' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'link'`).

## Command

`import { Command, CommandDialog, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandSeparator, CommandShortcut, CommandTrigger } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A filterable, keyboard-navigable list, grouped by section: the shape a command palette is built on. Bare for an inline picker; `CommandDialog` puts it in a dialog.

Also takes: bits-ui `Command.Root` props.

### `CommandDialog`

`Command` in a `Dialog`, for a palette that takes over the screen. The title and description are for a screen reader only.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | `'Command palette'` |  |
| `description` | `string` | `'Search for a command to run.'` |  |
| `showCloseButton` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` (required) | `Snippet` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Dialog.Root` props except `children`, `child`; bits-ui `Command.Root` props except `children`, `child`.

### `CommandEmpty`

Shown when nothing matches what was typed.

Also takes: bits-ui `Command.Empty` props.

### `CommandGroup`

A section of items, under a small muted heading.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `string` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Command.Group` props.

### `CommandInput`

The search field, with its glyph, ruled off from the list below.

Also takes: bits-ui `Command.Input` props.

### `CommandItem`

One command. The highlighted row takes the muted wash, as a menu row does.

Also takes: bits-ui `Command.Item` props.

### `CommandList`

The scrolling list of groups and items.

Also takes: bits-ui `Command.List` props.

### `CommandSeparator`

A rule between groups.

Also takes: bits-ui `Command.Separator` props.

### `CommandShortcut`

A keyboard shortcut, muted at the end of the item.

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

### `CommandTrigger`

The "Type to search… ⌘K" field in a header, which opens a command palette. Header-sized (`h-8`, as the portals draw it); a trigger beside form inputs takes `class="h-9 rounded-2xl"` to match them.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the palette is open. Opened on click, toggled on the hotkey. |
| `hotkey` | `string \| false` | `'k'` | The key that, with ⌘ or Ctrl, toggles `open`. `false` registers none and hides the hint. |
| `children` | `Snippet` |  | The label. Defaults to "Type to search…". |

Also takes: every `<button>` attribute.

## ThemeToggle

`import { ThemeProvider, ThemeToggle, ThemeState, useTheme } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Icon-only toggle between light and dark, inside a `ThemeProvider`.

Also takes: everything `Button` takes except `children`, `onclick`.

### `ThemeProvider`

Applies a `light` / `dark` class to `<html>` and persists the choice. The class on the root is what Tailwind's `dark:` variant reads, so this touches the DOM directly rather than passing a value down alone.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultTheme` | `'dark' \| 'light' \| 'system'` | `'system'` |  |
| `storageKey` | `string` | `'vite-ui-theme'` | localStorage key. Distinct per app, so two apps on one host do not share a theme. |
| `children` (required) | `Snippet` |  |  |

Also exports: `ThemeState`, `useTheme`.

Types: `Theme` (`'dark' | 'light' | 'system'`).
